title: North Georgia Trout Fishing LLC

services.name: Guided Wade Fishing Trips
services.desc: If I don't pick up your call, I am probably on the water. Leave me a message and I will get back to you as soon as I can! Floating the Toccoa River tailwater in our drift boats is by far our most popular trip option, and it is perfect for learning how to trout fish. Our drift boats are stable and safe enough to take guests from 5 to 100 years old on low or high water levels. All anglers must have a valid Georgia freshwater fishing license and trout license. Be sure to dress appropriately for the weather and pack any snacks or drinks you'd like. Don't forget a hat and sunglasses! Each boat fits two anglers and a dedicated guide, and we have multiple boats available for larger
